name: Aokusa Natsu
source:
Birth year: 1990

Main character of "Story 3 - Crimson hair"

Natsu is the daughter of [url=/c88248]Tsubame[/url]'s mother's friend. Her family owns a villa at the beach where Tsubame and [url=/c88249]You[/url] pay a visit in the last few days of their summer holiday.

Natsu is a second-year high school student. She has a shy personality, more or less of a hikikomori. As the story progresses, she gradually opens up to Tsubame and You when she gets to know more about them.
